DGCA Bans Specific Power Bank Model on Flights After Fire Incident

India's Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has banned the MOBIKINS model power bank on all flights following a fire incident involving an IndiGo aircraft. Power banks containing lithium-ion batteries can pose a fire risk if damaged or affected by internal short circuits, according to reports.
